termination_reason: All outstanding challenges have been addressed. The Proposer has accepted, defended, or revised the proposal across three rounds in response to Critic feedback. Challenge C9 is now resolved with explicit addition of post-launch governance requirements to conditional scope. No unresolved challenges remain. The scope is coherent: core feature logic (inactivity detection with human review and alerting) is clearly defined; included and excluded behaviors are explicit; success criteria are observable and testable; assumptions are material and visible; and material external dependencies (stakeholder inputs on engagement activity, thresholds, exemptions, routing, access control, and post-launch governance) are honestly represented and assigned to appropriate owners. The five blocking open questions (engagement activity definition, inactivity threshold, exemption criteria, alert routing, access-control workflow) are legitimate external dependencies held by Operations, Regional Leadership, and Security stakeholders, not deficiencies in the proposal. The proposal is ready to be documented and handed to stakeholders for the required decisions. Another exchange is unlikely to improve the proposal without new information from stakeholders.
